 "scheduleType": "Lecture",
 "credits": 3,
 "nuPath": [],
 "description": "Focuses on the health assessment of newborns, children, adolescents, and their families within a community. Discusses issues most pertinent to the various ages of the well child within a culturally-competent primary care framework of anticipatory guidance and health promotion. Emphasizes the utilization of a comprehensive approach to preventative healthcare by examining the impact of psychological, sociological, developmental, behavioral, cultural, and physiological factors on the child’s health status within the family and community. Includes routine healthcare maintenance, screening, developmental issues, genetic implications, family dynamics, confidentiality, adoption, global health, self-care, and common health concerns encountered in pediatric primary care settings.",
